concerns.text: Success criterion SC-003 (computational efficiency measured against a fixed time budget) has no corresponding task that records, benchmarks, or verifies runtime performance. No task defines a timing metric, log, or threshold check.

Success criterion SC-004 (empirical Type I error rates must be within ±0.005 of the nominal 0.05) is not explicitly verified by any task. Tasks T005/T006 aggregate error rates but do not assert the ±0.005 tolerance.
Success criterion SC-005 (measure magnitude of error‑rate inflation under non‑normal conditions) lacks a dedicated task. No task computes or validates this robustness metric.

The `test_result.schema.yaml` contract is never validated by any task. While T003 implements statistical tests, it does not include a verification step that the generated `TestResult` records conform to the schema.
